cases.name: registration-getter
cases.source: const errors=[];process.on('uncaughtException',error=>{errors.push(error.message)});let result;let reads=0,caught=false,registered=false;const t=new EventTarget();try{t.addEventListener('test',{get handleEvent(){reads++;throw new Error('GETTER_REGISTRATION')}});registered=true}catch(error){caught=error.message==='GETTER_REGISTRATION'}await new Promise(resolve=>setImmediate(resolve));result={reads,caught,registered};console.log(JSON.stringify({result,errors}));

cases.name: dispatch-getter
cases.source: const errors=[];process.on('uncaughtException',error=>{errors.push(error.message)});let result;let reads=0,armed=false,dispatchCaught=false,second=0;const t=new EventTarget();t.addEventListener('test',{get handleEvent(){reads++;if(armed)throw new Error('GETTER_DISPATCH');return()=>{}}});t.addEventListener('test',()=>second++);armed=true;try{t.dispatchEvent(new Event('test'))}catch{dispatchCaught=true}await new Promise(resolve=>setImmediate(resolve));result={reads,dispatchCaught,second};console.log(JSON.stringify({result,errors}));

cases.name: direct-finalizer
cases.source: const errors=[];process.on('uncaughtException',error=>{errors.push(error.message)});let result;let seen=0;const registry=new FinalizationRegistry(()=>{seen++;throw new Error('DIRECT_FINALIZER')});function register(){registry.register({},0)}register();for(let i=0;i<30&&seen===0;i++){globalThis.gc();await new Promise(resolve=>setImmediate(resolve));}result={seen};console.log(JSON.stringify({result,errors}));

limits: Node oracle only; public uncaughtException handler captures errors in isolated fresh processes.
--expose-gc triggers ordinary Node collection solely to schedule FinalizationRegistry; no DEBUG/fault/private memory introspection.
Finalizer timing is bounded by explicit attempts; no universal GC scheduling/order guarantee is inferred.
